component.name: Jap Studio
component.summary: Native GPU-accelerated DAW in a single canvas
DAW nativo acelerado por GPU en un solo lienzo

description.p: Jap Studio (Hay / Elevate) is a native Rust and GPUI digital audio workstation built around a single-canvas workflow so you can compose, design sounds, mix, and collaborate without jumping between windows.
Jap Studio (Hay / Elevate) es un DAW nativo en Rust y GPUI diseñado en un solo lienzo para componer, diseñar sonidos, mezclar y colaborar sin saltar entre ventanas.

ul.li: Low-latency PipeWire and ALSA audio engine with live monitoring and multi-track recording
Hay Synth native wavetable synthesizer supporting .vital, .vitalbank, and .fxp presets
Click-free PCM Drums Sampler and 4x4 MPC Pads with 16 Levels, Note Repeat RT, and transient Chop
Native FX rack (Hay EQ, Comp with real Sidechain, Limiter, Echo, Reverb, Filter, Spectrum) plus VST3 hosting
Acoustic Explorer (offline DSP analysis), Piano Roll with MPE pitch curves, and Lua Tejer routing
Live P2P collaboration over Loro CRDT and Iroh QUIC plus built-in MCP server for AI tools

screenshot.caption: Multi-track Arrangement, native FX rack, and Spectrum in the Cuaderno Oscuro theme
Arrangement multipista, cadena FX nativa y Spectrum en el tema Cuaderno Oscuro
Single-canvas workflow uniting Arrangement, Piano Roll, Sampler, FX, MPC, and MCP
Flujo en un solo lienzo con Arrangement, Piano Roll, Sampler, FX, MPC y MCP
4x4 MPC Pads and click-free PCM Drums Sampler with 16 Levels and Note Repeat RT
Pads MPC 4×4 y sampler de batería PCM sin clics con 16 Levels y Note Repeat RT

description.p: Polyphonic MPE in Hay Synth and Piano Roll (pitch curves, Slide Y, Pressure Z), full 5-language JSON i18n (ES/EN/PT/FR/JA), 3 shortcut profiles (Jap/Ableton/FL), global font sizing and redesigned Appearance settings, right-click clear on MIDI capture buffer, lock-free LFO modulation, live monitoring latency readout, and MPC pad-click crash fix.

First Flathub release of Jap Studio featuring Hay Synth (.vital/.fxp), click-free PCM Drums and 4x4 MPC Pads, Clip Warp, native FX with Sidechain, Acoustic Explorer, live P2P collaboration, MCP AI server, and Cuaderno Light/Dark themes.
